label: TOTP two-factor authentication
query: implement totp-based two-factor authentication for open webui login, including enrollment with a qr code, recovery codes, and an admin toggle to require it

label: Access control for shared chats
query: add access control and permissions for shared chats so a shared conversation can be limited to specific users or groups instead of being public to anyone with the link

label: Separate content-extraction settings
query: add separate content-extraction settings for chat uploads versus knowledge base documents so each can use a different extraction engine and configuration

label: Confirm inputs to MCP tools
query: add a confirmation step in the ui that shows the inputs being passed to an mcp tool and asks the user to approve before the tool call runs

label: Upload files without processing
query: add an option to upload files without any backend processing or text extraction, so a raw file can be stored and attached to a chat as-is

label: OpenAI realtime voice API
query: integrate the openai realtime voice api so users can have a live spoken conversation with the model, streaming audio in and out over a websocket

label: External data-source connectors
query: build a system of external data-source connectors so users can connect open webui to outside sources like databases, apis, or cloud drives and query them in chat

label: Nextcloud documents integration
query: add a nextcloud integration so users can browse and import their nextcloud documents into open webui as knowledge base files

label: Knowledge base image import + OCR
query: add image support to the knowledge base so users can upload images and scanned documents, run ocr to extract text, and view the original image alongside the extracted content

label: Native companion mobile app
query: build a native companion mobile app for open webui that connects to a self-hosted server, supports chat with streaming responses, voice input, and push notifications
